requiredCases.title: Package identity
requiredCases.requirement: Every packaged artifact, version label, runtime identity, and manager pin agrees with rel.json.

requiredCases.title: Standard-mode control
requiredCases.requirement: Standard mode preserves the game's normal spawn behavior and performs no HRS relocation or trader mutation.

requiredCases.title: Random spawn NG01
requiredCases.requirement: A fresh Random game may select NG01 and must complete a safe, stable, one-shot relocation.

requiredCases.title: Random spawn NG02
requiredCases.requirement: A fresh Random game may select NG02 and must complete a safe, stable, one-shot relocation.

requiredCases.title: Nearest trader routing
requiredCases.requirement: After relocation, the phase-one opening trader objective selects the nearest reviewed Navezgane trader by planar distance.

requiredCases.title: Starter quest continuation
requiredCases.requirement: quest_whiteRiverCitizen1 phase one points to the selected nearest trader and then continues through vanilla quest progression.

requiredCases.title: Reload is one-shot
requiredCases.requirement: Reloading an already relocated character does not perform another relocation or replace completed state.

requiredCases.title: Unsupported environment fails closed
requiredCases.requirement: Wrong game build, EAC-enabled play, multiplayer, dedicated server, or non-Navezgane context cannot perform relocation.

requiredCases.title: Removal and rollback
requiredCases.requirement: Remove from Game removes only verified HRS-owned files, preserves unknown or changed files, and leaves the owned release path absent after a clean removal.
